title: Pope Gregory XIII issues the calendar reform bull
summary: With the bull Inter gravissimas, Gregory XIII ordered that ten days be dropped in October 1582 and introduced new leap year rules, creating the Gregorian calendar.
reason: The Julian calendar had drifted about ten days from the solar year, moving the date of Easter away from the spring equinox.
significance: The Gregorian calendar became the civil calendar of nearly the whole world.
